# k0rdent_project (List Resource)

Finds every `k0rdent_project` a `terraform query` can adopt, by its identity. With `include_resource = true`, or under `-generate-config-out`, each result also carries the object as an import of that identity would read it, so the generated configuration is what an import plans against. Terraform 1.14 and later.

Every project the provider's credential can see, in one organization or in all of them. An object being deleted is left out: adopting it plans against something about to be gone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every project in one organization.
list "k0rdent_project" "acme" {
  provider = k0rdent

  config {
    organization_id = "org-acme"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `organization_id` (String) Organization to search. Left out, every organization the credential can see is searched. **Constraints:** Must be lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter and not ending with a hyphen (`[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?`), because it becomes a segment of a request URL. String length must be at most 63.

## Related

- [`k0rdent_project`](../resources/project.md) resource: manages one, and is what each result is adopted as.
